caption: The drawing features a metallic kitchen utensil with an elongated handle ending in a small circular hole, likely for hanging. The main section of the utensil consists of a flat, rectangular base supported by two curved, angled legs. On top of the base, there are two sets of three arched dividers with ornate scrollwork at their bases, forming two adjacent compartments. Above this utensil, there is a secondary, inset drawing labeled "PLAN" that shows a simple line drawing of the handle and a cross-section of the base from above, indicating its structure and the positioning of the arched dividers. The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil, and the background is plain with a faint frame sketched around the edges. The name "Mildred Ford" is written in the lower left corner.
title: Toast Rack
